hero.subtitle: We are completely transforming our space in Blagoevgrad and redefining the Elegant experience. Contact us for inquiries, updates, and early access.

footer.description: © 2024-26 Elegant. A digital retreat for calm, clarity, and renewal.

space.title: A calm home for rest, ritual, and renewal
space.intro: The center is shaped around softness, quiet attention, and a sense of pause. Every room carries the feeling of a place designed to slow time and welcome stillness.
space.details: The material palette, natural light, and careful composition create an atmosphere that feels both grounded and gently elevated. This is a space for presence rather than performance.

journey.title: A season of renewal and becoming
journey.intro: What you see now is part of a larger becoming. The center is being renovated, the brand is being redefined, and the experience is being shaped into something more refined and more personal.
journey.body: We are in the middle of a thoughtful transformation — one that touches the physical space, the identity of the brand, and the way the experience is presented online. It is a process grounded in care, curiosity, and a desire to create something lasting.
journey.focus: The work is not only about change, but about clarity. We are shaping the space and the story so that the experience feels deeper, calmer, and more intentional for every visitor.
journey.closing: This chapter is about creating a new kind of welcome — one that is quieter, clearer, and more meaningful.
journey.renovationAlt: A calm visual of the renovation process and the new design direction

updates.title: Notes from the unfolding process
updates.intro: Here we share the small and significant moments as the space evolves — from renovation progress to quiet shifts in atmosphere and the development of the experience itself.

0.title: Renovation begins with the studio floor
0.text: We are carefully restoring the main studio and shaping the new flow of the space with softness, clarity, and intention.

1.title: A new visual language is taking shape
1.text: Our rebranding is moving from concept into a more tactile, editorial expression — calm, understated, and rooted in the experience of being here.

2.title: The website is being reimagined
2.text: We are refining the way the experience is presented online, building a more thoughtful and immersive entry point for visitors before they even arrive.

contact.title: Get in touch
contact.intro: Whether you are planning a visit, asking a question, or simply want to say hello, we would be glad to hear from you.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.body:
At Wellness Center Elegant, we care about your privacy and the trust you place in us. This policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and the choices you have when you visit our website or reach out to us.

We may collect basic information you provide voluntarily, such as your name, email address, phone number, or message content when you contact us through our forms, email, or social channels. We also use standard website analytics to understand how visitors use the site, which helps us improve the experience over time.

The information we collect is used to respond to your inquiries, share relevant updates, improve our services, and maintain the security and performance of our website. We do not sell your personal information. We may share limited information with trusted service providers that help us operate the website and communicate with our visitors, subject to confidentiality obligations.

You may choose not to provide certain information, though this may limit our ability to respond to your request or provide the information you seek. If you would like to request access to, correction of, or deletion of your information, please contact us directly.

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any significant changes will be reflected on this page.
